besluite.fout: Missing AWS comma before 'en' joining two clauses that each have their own subject and verb.
besluite.rede: Both 'Hy het ... laat staan' and ''n kol skimmel het ... gegroei' are full clauses, so the AWS 2017 comma is required and nothing else changes.
Putting the place phrase after 'dood' is acceptable Afrikaans, and the proposal adds a comma in 'duidelike, skoon ring' that splits 'skoon ring', the unit the lesson's title names.

besluite.fout: Spoken-style omission of 'dat' and a missing AWS comma, so 'doodmaak en hy' makes the reader stumble.
besluite.rede: The written 'dat' clause with the verb at the end, plus the required comma before the new main clause, reads more naturally and keeps the meaning exactly.

besluite.fout: 'kon dit nie medisyne maak nie' is ungrammatical: 'van' is missing.
besluite.rede: 'nie medisyne daarvan maak nie' is the correct construction, says the same thing, and leaves the protected body sentence untouched.

besluite.fout: Missing AWS comma before 'en' joining two clauses with their own subject and verb.
besluite.rede: 'Fleming kon ... kry' and 'dit het gou verswak' are separate clauses; the comma goes after the protected wording and leaves it intact.

besluite.fout: 'skoon ... gemaak' reads as 'cleaned' and echoes the 'skoon ring' of the earlier block.
besluite.rede: 'suiwer' is the exact, Grade 6-friendly word for a purified substance, and the meaning stays the same.

besluite.fout: 'op siek mense gewys' copies English 'showed on patients'; 'wys' normally means showing something to someone.
besluite.rede: In both versions the Oxford team proved, in sick people, that the drug works; 'by siek mense getoon' is the idiomatic way to say it and keeps the protected 'siek mense'.

besluite.fout: 'het verander hoe ... behandel het' copies English 'changed how' and stacks two 'het's.
besluite.rede: 'het die manier verander waarop' is the natural Afrikaans construction, and the present form in the subordinate clause is normal after a past main verb, so the meaning does not move.
